title: Teodoro rejects oil exploration with China, says ‘no legal basis’

blocks.text: Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Tuesday reiterated his opposition to joint oil and gas exploration with China in the West Philippine Sea, saying Beijing has no valid claim over the area and that there is no legal basis for such an arrangement.
